scope: Read-only source and retained-artifact assessment of the two declared changes after the formal performance candidate. This is not a repeated performance run.

driver.setup: fresh(variant) is called once for each of the two variants; each call creates its own context and one page.

storageListener.basis: Inference from the fingerprinted driver, final applied patch scope and documented native storage-event routing.
storageListener.nativeRouting: Own-document localStorage writes do not fire the storage event on that same document. Other-document delivery requires a shared storage area and same origin.
storageListener.assessment: The isolated one-page contexts and distinct origins provide no second document to notify the measured page; the driver does not synthesize a storage event. The known final listener branch is therefore outside the exercised timing path. This is a source/protocol inference, not a retrospectively recorded zero-event count.

recoveryCss.scope: Exactly two added .recovery-content button.primary normal/hover background, text and border color rules.
recoveryCss.assessment: The timed fixtures load valid saves before arming measurement and exercise normal inventory, combat and loot screens. The two new recovery-only selectors do not match those recorded flows. CSS loading/parsing occurs before the click-timing windows. This does not establish byte-identical final performance.

knownDifferences.scope: Only the native storage-event listener: protect surviving memory when queued deletion notices arrive after another tab has written a replacement; preserve same-state presentation.
Only primary-button normal/hover colors below .recovery-content on the recovery screen.

requiredFinalChecks: Actual cross-tab queued deletion and replacement regression on final app source
Normal inventory and main-action smoke on final source
Recovery primary-button normal/hover contrast visual check
decision: A complete new 46-window performance matrix is not necessary to validate these two narrowly scoped fixes if the final focused checks pass. Keep the existing matrix labeled as measured candidate, keep DIFFERENT_DECLARED, and retain all software-renderer and missing-stage limitations. Do not state final source was benchmarked byte-for-byte.
candidateBodyLimitation: The historical app.js and save-recovery.css bodies were not independently preserved by this reviewer. Their measured hashes/HTTP hashes and exact author-recorded applied patches remain intact. No inverse reconstruction was performed.
